narrative.intro: Blue Origin has $99.2M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date, spread across 2 awards with an average award size of $49.6M. Obligations are down 90.9% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year show early activity in FY22 at $357K, growth through FY23 and FY24 at $15.8M and $10.6M, a jump to $106M in FY25, a peak at $1.1B in FY26, and the current FY27 total of $99.2M. The award count and average award size indicate a concentrated set of large awards rather than many small contracts. The year-over-year decline quantifies a steep reduction in obligations compared with the prior fiscal period. Contractors and contracting officers looking at Blue Origin should note the uneven multi-year profile: small activity in FY22 through FY24, one large step-up in FY25 and FY26, and a return to a smaller set of obligations in FY27. This pattern matters for capture planning, teaming decisions, and capacity assumptions when evaluating Blue Origin as a potential prime or subcontractor.
